tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): Ghostty 1.4.0 at its shipped default configuration exposes no readback of OSC 133;D. notify-on-command-finish defaults to never and its action to bell without notify (src/config/Config.zig:1214, 1228-1231), a notification also needs a command longer than five seconds (src/config/Config.zig:1265), and the path reaching sendDesktopNotification is gated on all three (src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1192-1218). OSC 133;D itself only sets internal row content (src/terminal/Terminal.zig:2266-2271). The run is at that default by construction: a launch naming any notification setting is refused as non-default, so a notification read cannot grade this row. The route needs notify-on-command-finish set away from never, which changes what Ghostty does when a command ends (it rings or posts a desktop notification), so it is a behaviour setting, not an observer-only switch (@cto 9de3bba2).

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): Ghostty 1.4.0 at its shipped default configuration exposes no readback of OSC 133;D. notify-on-command-finish defaults to never and its action to bell without notify (src/config/Config.zig:1214, 1228-1231), a notification also needs a command longer than five seconds (src/config/Config.zig:1265), and the path reaching sendDesktopNotification is gated on all three (src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1192-1218). OSC 133;D itself only sets internal row content (src/terminal/Terminal.zig:2266-2271). The run is at that default by construction: a launch naming any notification setting is refused as non-default, so a notification read cannot grade this row. The route needs notify-on-command-finish set away from never, which changes what Ghostty does when a command ends (it rings or posts a desktop notification), so it is a behaviour setting, not an observer-only switch (@cto 9de3bba2).
